observations.statement: All43 allowed trials succeeded operationally with null errors. Count correction, crossed products, several gradient replacements and action/mean branches contain scientific negative results, not failed model executions. No unreported failures are inferred.

Static, pooled and target-aware reference AUCs are0.6050036145,0.6102261137,0.6133619861. History contributes predictive signal under the frozen benchmark; this alone does not identify behavior semantics.
Full count correction lowers pooling and DIN AUC. Half correction improves pooling relative to ordinary pooling but still lowers DIN AUC; a weaker follow-up did not rescue the target-aware mechanism.

Aligned product restrictions improve the ordinary adapter; their single-factor cells interact. The ordinary adapter itself differs slightly from original DIN, so its joint gain must be measured against its own bridge. Aligned normalization improves AUC more than crossed normalization.

Full normalized-product differentiation beats detached, unit-scale identity and unit-scale tangent at seed42, but fixed0.2 tangent/identity nearly recover full AUC. Neither exact own-event inverse scaling nor tangent projection is established as necessary.

Whole-history mean is close in AUC with worse loss; chronological half, action-half and action-mean lose AUC. Adjacent replacements recover in both groupings. These negative controls delimit specific implementations rather than refute all behavior-aware modeling.

The ordering-by-offset AUC interaction is-0.0003459909071475975: chronological adjacent-minus-half=+0.00026890848463556605, rank adjacent-minus-half=-0.00007708242251203146. Rank-half leads AUC; rank-adjacent has lower Logloss. Temporal adjacency is not identified as necessary.

Both round14 variants reproduce incumbent AUC0.6151021885074872, Logloss0.19653258393542125 and all23 slice metrics/counts exactly, including round13 scale-half. This supports aggregate nonperturbation of the loss hook/probes at seed42; it supplies no new performance improvement or independent repetition.

All six rules have identical reported logits and BCE within each snapshot. All five alternative backward rules change raw-product and selected embedding gradients relative to full.

The incumbent exceeds full AUC by0.0001204973 and lowers loss by0.0000308237, while harming empty/short-history and frequency1-2 slices. These overlapping exploratory comparisons do not establish uniform or statistically reliable improvement.
